chunks: And what ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام, that he said:
"Every dwelling among your dwellings that you do not take as a permanent residence, then shortening the prayer is upon you there."

key_terms.تَسْتَوْطِنُهُ: you adopt it as a permanent residence
key_terms.مَنَازِلِكَ: your various dwellings or places where you stay
key_terms.مَنْزِلٍ: a dwelling or place of stay

ai.seo_question: When must a traveler shorten salat in a place where he is staying?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat during travel. It states that in any dwelling a person does not regard as a settled residence, the ruling is to perform shortened prayer there.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1309 - Ali ibn Yaqtin reported from Abu al-Hasan the First (as) who said:
"For every dwelling of yours that you do not consider a permanent residence, you must shorten your prayers there."
